title: Uploads over the device connection
spec: Requests 10 UploadBegin { room, name, size, sha256 }, 11 UploadChunk { upload, offset, bytes (1 to MAX_CHUNK) } and 12 UploadFinish { upload }, announced by FEATURE_FILES (4); UploadBegin and UploadFinish are answered Ok then an id frame (tag 133) with the upload's or the file's id, UploadChunk with Ok { bytes received }. DurableServer::with_files keeps bytes in a FileStore (sweeping unreferenced ones at start). begin_upload refuses, before any byte: no storage, a non-member, a bad name, a size of 0 or over MAX_FILE_SIZE, and more than MAX_UPLOADS (server) or MAX_UPLOADS_PER_PERSON in progress; uploads idle for UPLOAD_IDLE_MS are discarded. upload_chunk writes at any offset within the size (BadChunk otherwise) and only to the person's own upload (NoSuchUpload). finish_upload checks the content (WrongContent), checks membership again (NotMember if the person left), then records the file with its image size; a refused finish discards the upload. Refusals map to E_NO_STORAGE, E_NO_SUCH_ROOM, E_BAD_FILE, E_RATE_LIMITED and E_NO_SUCH_UPLOAD; the in-memory server answers E_NO_STORAGE. The installation keeps files in its data directory, and the network server advertises FEATURE_FILES.
